name: Global Runoff Data Centre (GRDC) River Discharge Database
description: Operated by the German Federal Institute of Hydrology (BfG) under the auspices of the World Meteorological Organization (WMO), the Global Runoff Data Centre (GRDC) maintains the primary worldwide repository of observed river discharge and streamflow records. The database contains standardized daily and monthly runoff series from more than 10,700 gauging stations across 160 countries, representing drainage areas of over 100 million km². It provides the baseline empirical benchmark for calibration and validation of global hydrological, land-surface, and climate models.
